candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All text and all ten furigana readings are correct and attached to the right words, including 努力(どりょく) on its first occurrence. Circled numbers kept and footer correct. Minor: first row of the word box is used as a table header, the book icon is omitted, and the double underline on 漢字 is not marked.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are all correct and correctly placed. The word box uses an empty header row, which is faithful to the box. Minor: 読んでみよう is not marked as a section heading, the footer bullet is rendered ◎, and the book icon is omitted.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: In ①, the furigana is misplaced as 応援していた（おうえん）. In ⑩, the どりょく reading on 努力 is missing. クラス and 名前 are merged into the H1 title. Remaining text and furigana are correct.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Invents a furigana reading 漢字(かんじ) in the instruction; the image has only a double underline there. Circled numbers ①–⑩ are replaced with a 1.–10. list. All other furigana are correct and correctly placed.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Several furigana are detached from their words: (さいきん) sits at the end of ④, and (せいせき)(のこ) sit at the end of ⑩. 努力(どりょく) is attached to the second occurrence instead of the first. Base text is otherwise correct.

rationale: A and B are both essentially flawless; A edges ahead for marking the section heading and matching the footer bullet. D has fully correct furigana placement but invents 漢字(かんじ) and drops the circled numbers. C misplaces one furigana and omits another. E is last because it misplaces or misattaches four readings.
